mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 45 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies with a Full Moon overhead, and please be aware that the air quality is moderate with an index of 52.

In city news, please be advised that a portion of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final pavement work, and fall leaf collection also begins on October 5, so remember to place your loose leaves behind the curb.

There is plenty to do in our area, including the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, plus yoga on September 28 and trivia nights starting September 29.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for his second offence of O W I after crashing his vehicle in the 700 block of Shooting Star Road.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
